claims.statement: In the inherited r39 physical-pair diffuse branch, with S>S0=1/(480 sqrt(7626)) and ell_j<=3/4, define Zagg=sum_j S^2(1-ell_j)d_j^2. Some literal physical split has Z3>=27 Zagg/256. Hence Zagg>=2^-50 pays the full law by ||p_Q||_infty<=2048 sqrt(3)e^(1/3)<4950.573.

If instead Zagg<2^-50, then A[L,L]=Delta+V^T K V+E with K symmetric 2x2 and ||E||op<3/256. Combining with account03/B20 r39 gives A=diag(0_H,Delta)+K8+E*, rank K8<=8, ||E*||op<1/32, and s3(diag(0_H,Delta)+K8)>31/32. After conditioning H\T, the residual quadratic matrix is physical diagonal plus rank<=4 plus retained tail <3/256.

The target plus diffuse pair area does not force Zagg>0: A=[[0,V],[V^T,0]] with two flat orthonormal Walsh rows has nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}, all ell_j=2/m, and Zagg=0. This family is not a QFORM counterexample; pinned Theorem H gives ||p_Q||_infty<=4.
